scene: Arcs of bright blue lightning twist behind thick, buzzing glass.
picture: First-person close-up view of the giant glass containment jar. Blue lightning bolts snake across the transparent surface. On the jar's bottom left, a heavy brass dial is turned to zero. A taped paper warning note sits in the centre. Up high atop the cylinder, a polished copper terminal buzzes with bright static electricity.
shown: a large brass dial reading zero on the jar base at the bottom left
a yellow taped note with lightning hazard symbols placed in the centre
a glowing copper sphere sparking with mini bolts positioned up high
